column6: Requires warm water; excluded from Nordic regardless of which zone-agnostic coastal row (Beach, Reef, etc.) it is attached to. Matches the Reef biome rows own zone pattern (Temperate+Tropical only).
Permanent ice (Glacier/Glacier Runoff/Ice Floes) is Nordic+Temperate only; excluded from Tropical. Left eligible in Temperate since temperate rivers/lakes do freeze seasonally.
Arsenic ore only appears on Apex Caps/Glacier/Glacier Runoff/Snow Caps in the source chart, all Nordic+Temperate-restricted rows; excluded from Tropical.
Mercury ore, same cold-only pattern as As.
Nickel ore, same cold-only pattern as As.
Volcanic glass, only ever listed on cold-summit rows in the source chart; excluded from Tropical.
Sulfur ore, same cold-only pattern as As.
Antimony ore, same cold-only pattern as As.
Hazard only ever listed on Marsh/Swamp, both Temperate+Tropical-restricted rows; excluded from Nordic.
